title: cyanus solstitialis
intro: Cyanus solstitialis, commonly known as cornflower, is a small annual plant in the daisy family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The cornflower is valued for its health benefits, including its use in treating fever, coughs, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of cornflower include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of the cornflower plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
